body:
sara: Heads-up: docs PR #7834 needs snippet fixes for streaming + pagination + retry. Current examples can duplicate items when a retry restarts mid-page.

maria: I can patch Py/TS/Go examples. Paste the minimal bad snippets and suggested patterns so coverage is consistent.

sara: Bad TS snippet: `for await (const p of client.streamList()) { for (const i of p.items) yield i }` -> on retry this can re-yield. Suggestion: prefer server cursor when returned; otherwise maintain a seen-id set per stream and skip duplicates.

ben: Python pattern: keep last_cursor and a seen set. On resume, request with cursor and skip items with id in seen. Add note about memory and TTL cleanup.

tom: Go: show a small `wrapDeduper(cb)` helper using map[string]struct{} to avoid reprocessing. Keep snippet short.

lee: CI note: add a unit-test-style snippet that simulates a retry mid-page. QA should run against hosted + dedicated infra.

ci-bot: CI: snippet-lint passed for changed files, example-tests flaky on py-stream-retry. See https://ci.redwood.internal/12034

maria: Pushed branch `docs/stream-pagination-dedupe`. WIP PR updated with three language patches and checklist. Asking @ben/@tom for review once tests stabilized.

sara: Thanks 44d once merged I'll copyedit and close.
